caption: Ano Syros, Ermoupoli
composition: Catholic hill lanes up to the three-story bell tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Cobbled lanes and white houses climb the Catholic hill of Ano Syros to the Cathedral of Saint George, a white basilica with a cylindrical vault and one three-story bell tower: an arched door, a round clock, and a triple-arch belfry under a small cupola. The harbor of Ermoupoli shows below the hill. Midday is partly cloudy, cloud cover about 41 percent, about 20.9°C, and dry. The Town Hall and Vaporia are not the subject.
